apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.noQuotaAlerts: No quota alerts at the moment

form.ipWhitelistPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all IPs
form.ipWhitelistHint: IP addresses allowed to use this key; empty means no restriction
form.tokenLimitHint: Daily token usage cap; 0 means no limit
form.rateLimitHint: Per-minute request rate cap; 0 means no limit
form.thresholdHint: Trigger an alert when quota usage reaches this ratio
form.rotationPeriodHint: Auto-rotation period for the key (in days); 0 means no auto-rotation

keyValueDialog.tip: Please save the key value below. It is shown only once:
keyValueDialog.warning: The key value is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again after closing this dialog! If you lose it, use the reset function to generate a new key.

import.note1: A new key value will be generated for each key on import; key values from the original config are not imported.
import.mergeNote: MERGE mode: keeps existing keys and only adds new ones.
import.replaceNote: REPLACE mode: deletes all existing keys before importing new ones.
import.uploadText: Drag a JSON file here, or
import.newKeysTitle: New key values (shown only once — please save them)

confirmations.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete API key {keyId}? This action cannot be undone.
confirmations.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately, and the new one is shown only once.
confirmations.rotateMessage: Are you sure you want to rotate API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately, and the new one is shown only once. The lastRotatedAt timestamp will be updated.
confirmations.quotaResetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset the daily quota counter of API key {keyId}? This clears today's request and token usage.
